# Town of Georgia municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Georgia Selectboard members: Kellie Bosenberg (Chair), Brian Dunsmore (Vice Chair), Tammy Hardy, Judith Nasca, and Carl Rosenquist.
Town of Georgia Selectboard page (townofgeorgia.com): the board has five members -- three elected to three-year terms and two to one-year terms on a staggered basis.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lori Hobart as Georgia Town Treasurer (January 2026).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Lori Hobart as Georgia's Treasurer.

Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': the Town Treasurer's office is NOT among the local offices open in 2026, so Hobart's term did not stand at the March 2026 meeting.
Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': the Town Clerk's office stood in 2026 for a three-year term; no outcome is published. Structure only.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cheryl Letourneau as Georgia Town Clerk (January 2026).

Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': the Town Moderator's office stood in 2026 for one year; the holder is named in no source read. Structure only.

Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': the First Constable's office stood in 2026 for one year; the holder is named in no source read. Structure only.

Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': the Second Constable's office stood in 2026 for one year; the holder is named in no source read. Structure only.
Town of Georgia Elections & Voting page (townofgeorgia.com), 'Local Offices Open for 2026': three Library Trustee seats stood in 2026 for one year -- the seats are elected.

Georgia Public Library trustee minutes, January 21, 2026 (georgiapubliclibraryvt.org): the board has five trustees (Nicole Jamison, Chair; Debbie Mann; Kollene Caspers; Terry Cleveland; Craig Volatile-Wood). That roster predates the March 2026 meeting at which three seats stood, so no holders are minted. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Georgia justice of the peace seats, eleven named and one printed 'Open': Alan Parent, Jacqui Hood, Ed Ballantyne, Karen Brigham, Linda Cramer, Brian Dunsmore, Justin Holmes, Paul Jansen, Jen Kale, Craig Volatile-Wood, and Tony Heinlein.

jp_election.name: Town of Georgia Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names eleven Georgia winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election and prints the twelfth seat as 'Open'; the contest carries vote_for 12 with eleven winners and the vacancy is the listing's own. Georgia elects its Planning Commissioners (a four-year seat and a one-year remainder stood in 2026), but no source read fixes the commission's size, so no post is created; the town has an appointed Town Assessor (no listers) and its audits are performed by an outside firm (no auditor post).
